Final Integration, Appendices, and Publication Guidance

architectural_decisions.decision: Treat configuration completion as portfolio-relative rather than a fixed candidate score.
Separate configuration detection, completion bonus, and optional synthesis generation into staged capabilities.
Use Bre Moon-Saturn-North Node as a named regression fixture without hard-coding a required final selection outcome.
Treat utility calibration as a versioned engineering process rather than informal weight tuning.
Separate intrinsic, bundle, marginal, and portfolio-level utility in diagnostics.
Adopt exact-selection and invariant golden fixtures.
Separate source, dependency, transformation, decision, and historical provenance.
Treat layered provenance as authoritative and flattened provenance as a compatibility projection.
Do not treat optimizer rationale as semantic source evidence.
Canonicalize candidates before identity assignment, equivalence merging, conflict grouping, scoring, and optimization.
Use schema-aware normalization that preserves meaningful direction, roles, and ordered configuration structure.
Treat canonicalization profiles as versioned migration boundaries and preserve old-to-new identity lineage.
Use a versioned Candidate Registry as the authoritative source for shared candidate vocabulary and schema contracts.
Reserve deprecated identifiers permanently and prohibit semantic repurposing.
Pin registry and compatibility profile versions in completion logs and replayable artifacts.
Adopt the REC-020 logical stage sequence as the authoritative Semantic Basis Extractor execution contract.
Require canonicalization before identity, equivalence merging before scoring, and provenance finalization after optimization.
Treat materialization as a read-only projection over finalized selection and provenance.
Require completion logs and QA status to reflect only stages and checks that actually executed.
Distinguish semantic, metric, artifact, byte, and historical reproducibility claims.
Require replay modes to declare reused, recomputed, and migrated stages explicitly.
Require replay equivalence reports and prohibit silent profile or registry substitution.
